notes.title: 1.01 Update
notes.content:
◆Bug fix
1.Typo fix
2.Selection order fix

◆Game launch with Minimized window
The reason causing the problem is the save data crushed,
Please access the path down below and delete the save data.
C:\Users\%username%\AppData\LocalLow\DieselMine 
It should fix the game launching problem.

◆The solution of game save data lost or crushed
We are very sorry for the BUG of game save data lost or crushed,
We will Upload a full CG save data for every player

※Replace the save data
1.Download and unzip the save data, put it into DieselMine file, 
which is under the game save data path

※Download link 
DropBox:https://www.dropbox.com/s/iktja7xc78lv1m9/Twins%20of%20the%20Pasture.zip?dl=0
